column3: With respect to the Sunshine Lake MHC Portfolio Mortgage Loan (7.3%), from and after the business day immediately following the second anniversary of the first debt service payment date, the borrowers may, other than within 60 days before or after a securitization, (i) obtain the release of one or more individual Mortgaged Properties (each, an “Individual Property”) from the lien of the Mortgage thereon and (ii) obtain the release of the applicable individual borrower that owns such Individual Property
